mapper.insert: insert into monitor_rule ( site_code, rule_no, rule_type, owner_user_id, rule_name, description, level, period_hours, duration_count, mute_hours, notify_enabled, notify_chat_id, notify_chat_name, notify_chats, currency, config, enabled, paused_at, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{siteCode}, #{ruleNo}, 'COND', #{ownerUserId}, #{ruleName}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{level}, 1, 1, #{muteHours}, #{notifyEnabled}, #{notifyChatId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notifyChatName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, coalesce(#{notifyChats,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[]')::jsonb, #{currency}, #{config}::jsonb, #{enabled}, #{pausedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: update monitor_rule set owner_user_id = #{rule.ownerUserId}, rule_name = #{rule.ruleName}, description = #{rule.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, level = #{rule.level}, mute_hours = #{rule.muteHours}, notify_enabled = #{rule.notifyEnabled}, notify_chat_id = #{rule.notifyChatId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notify_chat_name = #{rule.notifyChatName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notify_chats = coalesce(#{rule.notifyChats,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[]')::jsonb, currency = #{rule.currency}, config = #{rule.config}::jsonb, version = nextval('monitor_rule_version_seq'), update_by = #{rule.updateBy}, update_time = #{rule.updateTime}, edit_time = #{rule.updateTime}, edit_by = #{rule.updateBy} where rule_id = #{rule.ruleId} and site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and del_flag = '0' and rule_type = 'COND'
mapper.select: select distinct r.site_code from monitor_rule r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.enabled = true and r.rule_type = 'COND' order by r.site_code

select r.rule_id, s.run_start_hour, s.recent_periods::text as recent_periods, s.last_period_end, s.last_data_hour, s.detail::text as detail, e.event_id, e.start_hour as event_start_hour, e.trigger_hour as event_trigger_hour, e.detail::text as event_detail, e.handle_status as event_handle_status from monitor_rule r left join monitor_rule_state s on s.rule_id = r.rule_id and s.site_code = r.site_code left join monitor_event e on e.rule_id = r.rule_id and e.site_code = r.site_code and e.event_type = 'alert' and e.status = 'open' where r.rule_id in #{v}
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_rule_state (rule_id, site_code, run_start_hour, recent_levels, recent_periods, open_event_id, last_period_end, last_data_hour, detail, update_time) values (#{st.ruleId}, #{scope.siteCode}, #{st.runStartHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, '[]'::jsonb, coalesce(cast(#{st.recentPeriods,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb), '[]'::jsonb), #{st.eventId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{st.lastPeriodEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{st.lastDataHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, cast(#{st.detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb), now()) on conflict (rule_id) do update set run_start_hour = excluded.run_start_hour, recent_periods = excluded.recent_periods, open_event_id = excluded.open_event_id, last_period_end = excluded.last_period_end, last_data_hour = excluded.last_data_hour, detail = excluded.detail, update_time = excluded.update_time where monitor_rule_state.site_code = #{scope.siteCode}

insert into monitor_rule_state (rule_id, site_code, recent_levels, recent_periods, last_data_hour, update_time) values (#{ruleId}, #{scope.siteCode}, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, #{lastDataHour}, now()) on conflict (rule_id) do update set run_start_hour = null, recent_periods = '[]'::jsonb, open_event_id = null, last_period_end = null, last_data_hour = excluded.last_data_hour, detail = null, update_time = excluded.update_time where monitor_rule_state.site_code = #{scope.siteCode}

insert into monitor_event (site_code, rule_id, metric_code, rule_type, event_type, level, peak_level, escalated, status, start_hour, trigger_hour, last_period_end, rule_snapshot, detail, notify_status, mute_hours, handle_status, handle_reset, create_time, update_time) values (#{scope.siteCode}, #{e.ruleId}, null, 'COND', 'alert', #{e.level}, #{e.level}, false, 'open', #{e.startHour}, #{e.triggerHour}, #{e.lastPeriodEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, cast(#{e.ruleSnapshot} as jsonb), cast(#{e.detail} as jsonb), #{e.notifyStatus}, null, 'pending', false, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select e.event_id, e.rule_id, e.rule_type, e.level, e.status, e.start_hour, e.trigger_hour, e.end_hour, e.last_period_end, e.stopped_at, e.stop_reason, e.rule_snapshot::text as rule_snapshot, e.detail::text as detail, e.notify_status, e.handle_status, e.handle_note, coalesce(nullif(hu.email, ''), hu.user_name) as handled_by, e.handled_at, r.version as rule_version, coalesce(r.del_flag = '2', true) as rule_deleted from monitor_event e left join monitor_rule r on r.rule_id = e.rule_id and r.site_code = e.site_code left join sys_user hu on hu.user_id = e.handled_by where e.event_type = 'alert' and e.event_id = #{eventId}
